### Spatial Analysis
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

master_sf <- master_sf %>%
  mutate(
    rural_cat = case_when(
      RUCC_2013 <= 3 ~ "Urban (1-3)",
      RUCC_2013 <= 6 ~ "Semi-Rural (4-6)",
      RUCC_2013 >= 7 ~ "Rural (7-9)"
    ),
    rural_cat = factor(rural_cat, 
                       levels = c("Urban (1-3)", 
                                  "Semi-Rural (4-6)", 
                                  "Rural (7-9)"))
  )

ggplot(master_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = overdose_rate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name     = "Drug Overdose\nRate",
    na.value = "grey80",
    option   = "magma",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~rural_cat, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title    = "Drug Overdose Rates by Rural-Urban Classification",
    subtitle = "County-level rates, 2019",
    caption  = "Sources: CDC, USDA RUCC 2013"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
master_sf %>%
  filter(RUCC_2013 >= 7) %>%
  mutate(prison_present = factor(prison_present,
                                 levels = c(0, 1),
                                 labels = c("No Prison", "Prison Present"))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = overdose_rate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name      = "Drug Overdose\nRate",
    na.value  = "grey80",
    option    = "magma",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~prison_present, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title    = "Drug Overdose Rates by Prison Presence in Rural Counties",
    subtitle = "RUCC 7-9 counties, 2019",
    caption  = "Sources: CDC, USDA RUCC 2013, ICPSR"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
outcomes_full <- c(
  "overdose_rate"     = "Drug Overdose Rate",
  "suicide_rate"      = "Suicide Rate",
  "divorce_rate"      = "Divorce Rate",
  "life_exp_weighted" = "Life Expectancy (weighted)",
  "medhhinc"          = "Median Household Income",
  "unemp_rate"        = "Unemployment Rate",
  "pct_poverty"       = "Poverty Rate",
  "pct_white"         = "% White",
  "pct_black"         = "% Black",
  "pct_hispanic"      = "% Hispanic",
  "homeown_rate"      = "Homeownership Rate",
  "log_pop"           = "Log Population"
)

rural_only <- master_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(RUCC_2013 >= 7)

map_dfr(names(outcomes_full), function(var) {
  t <- t.test(rural_only[[var]] ~ rural_only$prison_present,
              na.action = na.omit)
  tibble(
    variable       = outcomes_full[[var]],
    mean_no_prison = t$estimate[1],
    mean_prison    = t$estimate[2],
    difference     = t$estimate[2] - t$estimate[1],
    p_value        = t$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    variable       = "Variable",
    mean_no_prison = "No Prison",
    mean_prison    = "Prison County",
    difference     = "Difference",
    p_value        = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(mean_no_prison, mean_prison, difference),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 4) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Rural Counties: Comparison by Prison Presence",
    subtitle = "Two-sample t-tests, RUCC 7-9 counties, 2019"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Group Means",
    columns = c(mean_no_prison, mean_prison)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#fff3cd"),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = p_value < 0.05
    )
  )
```


```{r}
master_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(RUCC_2013 >= 7) %>%
  mutate(
    prison_cat = case_when(
      prison_present == 0                                        ~ "No Prison",
      prison_present == 1 & is.na(capacity_total)               ~ "Prison: No Capacity Data",
      prison_present == 1 & capacity_total <= median(capacity_total, 
                            na.rm = TRUE)                        ~ "Prison: Small Capacity",
      prison_present == 1 & capacity_total > median(capacity_total, 
                            na.rm = TRUE)                        ~ "Prison: Large Capacity"
    ),
    prison_cat = factor(prison_cat, levels = c(
      "No Prison",
      "Prison: Small Capacity",
      "Prison: Large Capacity",
      "Prison: No Capacity Data"
    ))
  ) %>%
  group_by(prison_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n             = n(),
    overdose_mean = mean(overdose_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    suicide_mean  = mean(suicide_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    divorce_mean  = mean(divorce_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    life_exp_mean = mean(life_exp_weighted, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    prison_cat    = "County Type",
    n             = "N",
    overdose_mean = "Overdose Rate",
    suicide_mean  = "Suicide Rate",
    divorce_mean  = "Divorce Rate",
    life_exp_mean = "Life Expectancy"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(overdose_mean, suicide_mean, 
                 life_exp_mean),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = divorce_mean,
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Robustness Check: Overdose Rates by Prison Capacity",
    subtitle = "Rural counties (RUCC 7-9), 2019"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Mean Outcome by Group",
    columns = c(overdose_mean, suicide_mean, 
                divorce_mean, life_exp_mean)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "If elevated overdose rates were driven purely by in-prison 
    mortality, rates should scale with facility size. The inverse pattern 
    observed here is inconsistent with a pure compositional artifact.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = overdose_mean)
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(sf)

master_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(RUCC_2013 >= 7) %>%
  mutate(
    prison_cat = case_when(
      prison_present == 0                                        ~ "No Prison",
      prison_present == 1 & is.na(capacity_total)               ~ "Prison: No Capacity Data",
      prison_present == 1 & capacity_total <= median(capacity_total,
                            na.rm = TRUE)                        ~ "Prison: Small Capacity",
      prison_present == 1 & capacity_total > median(capacity_total,
                            na.rm = TRUE)                        ~ "Prison: Large Capacity"
    ),
    prison_cat = factor(prison_cat, levels = c(
      "No Prison",
      "Prison: Small Capacity",
      "Prison: Large Capacity",
      "Prison: No Capacity Data"
    ))
  ) %>%
  group_by(prison_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n             = n(),
    overdose_mean = mean(overdose_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    suicide_mean  = mean(suicide_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    divorce_mean  = mean(divorce_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    life_exp_mean = mean(life_exp_weighted, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    prison_cat    = "County Type",
    n             = "N",
    overdose_mean = "Overdose Rate",
    suicide_mean  = "Suicide Rate",
    divorce_mean  = "Divorce Rate",
    life_exp_mean = "Life Expectancy"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(overdose_mean, suicide_mean, life_exp_mean),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = divorce_mean,
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Rates by Prison Capacity",
    subtitle = "Rural counties (RUCC 7-9), 2019"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Mean Outcome by Group",
    columns = c(overdose_mean, suicide_mean, divorce_mean, life_exp_mean)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = prison_cat)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size  = px(13),
    data_row.padding = px(5)
  )
```
